subject: Helios Weekly Newsletter 2026 September 4
html:
September 4, 2026

Question of the Week: What mathematical concepts did our Hummingbirds explore this morning? Scroll to the end for the answer!

A NOTE FROM BEN

Dear Helios Families,

Welcome back! The first week is behind us and the classrooms are humming. A reminder that Monday, September 7 is Labor Day and there is no school.

Yours, Ben

ANNOUNCEMENTS & REMINDERS

Back to School Nights

Lower School Back to School Night is Wednesday, 9/9 at 6:00pm; Middle School is Thursday, 9/10 at 6:00pm. Adults only, please.

Carline Reminders

Please pull all the way forward in carline and keep the crosswalk clear. Staff will open doors; there is no need to get out of the car.

HCA NEWSLETTER

Welcome from the HCA

The Helios Community Association welcomes every family to the new year. The first HCA meeting is Tuesday, 9/15 at 8:30am in the library; coffee provided.

Fondue & Fort Night tickets are on sale

Saturday, 9/19 at the Whitfields'. Tickets on Helios Celebrate; a waitlist opens when they run out.

Answer of the week: Symmetry, by folding paper.
